outcome: maternal complications (transfusion, premature rupture of membranes, premature labor, uterine scar dehiscence, maternal complication during cesarean section)
cohort: The study included 17 patients who underwent open fetal myelomeningocele (MMC) repair at a specialized center in France between July 2014 and June 2020.
finding: Open fetal surgery for MMC repair leads to anatomical repair of the lesion, potential benefits on cerebral anomalies and motor function, with a low rate of perinatal and maternal complications.
mod_finding: There was no case of uterine scar dehiscence or maternal complication during cesarean section after fetal surgery.
gest_age: Average gestational age at delivery was 34+2 weeks
